notes.title: hello. Postponing the update of Easy Pose.
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/fcd7df2ccd3c39c146e3deea74b8f9f6c6184359.png[/img]

Notice - About Postponing the Update Schedule.

hello. Postponing the update of Easy Pose.

The mobile version of Easy Pose is the original. So we make the mobile version, then the Steam version.

However, we finished developing the new version about 2 weeks ago, but requested some improvements from the platform side.

1. Add a costume to the model shown in the pose preset icon of Easy Pose.
2. Removed couple poses that could be mistaken for sex poses.
3. Add delete account feature.

Unfortunately, we do not have professional graphic designers on our team. So, after the developer studied the graphics, they modified all about 1300 icons. We are also developing an account deletion function, but it is a complicated task and takes time.

As a result, the update schedule has been delayed beyond mid-September. If the platform rejects the update or requests for feature improvement, it may be delayed. Fortunately, the above improvements are not available in the Steam version.

We are very sorry for the inconvenience.

notes.title: Easy Pose version 0.95 update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/0a57d630d91923811979483e47208581d81851a2.png[/img]

- Project saving and group saving method change.

* Existing data storage methods are difficult to share files, and there is a limit to the number of slots that can be stored. So, we made it possible for the user to freely set the file storage path and file name.

- Added a feature that copies the edited hand pose to the other hand of the model and an Undo feature.

- Camera save bug fixed.

- Fixed an issue where the screen was broken when saving a group in 4K or higher resolution mode.

- Other bug fixes.

notes.title: Easy Pose 2020 last update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36659708/79090caf1e38bbf55fb545a5f0d6372677e63392.png[/img]

Hello! friends!

We are pleased to announce the update of Easy Pose for you! We'll complete the update on Steam and Google Play this week, then update the Apple App Store next week!

1. Oriental weapon package released! Includes 29 weapons, including Japanese swords, shuriken, and tonpa, and 80 poses for men and women each!

2. 24 group poses! (16 Sexual, 4 Couples, 4 Battles. Sexual is for Steam only. Google and Apple prohibit the update of adult content!)

3. Bug fixes and optimizations!

Server Backup feature of the pose data sharing and saving files are expected to be updated in January 2021. Thank you!
